perms.notificationsBody: Notifications are needed to keep the persistent connection status visible in the system bar — this prevents Android from killing the channel in the background.

ctl.title: Remote Control
ctl.accEnabled: Accessibility service enabled — remote control ready
ctl.accSteps:
Setup steps:
1. Tap the button below to open Accessibility settings directly.
2. Find NexusLink in the list of downloaded services.
3. Open it and turn on "Use service".
4. Confirm the warning dialog — the service does nothing outside a control session you explicitly accept.
ctl.confirmTitle: Ask for confirmation at session start
ctl.confirmSubtitle: When enabled, an Allow/Deny notification appears before the computer touches your screen. When disabled, sessions start automatically from trusted devices only.
ctl.trustedSubtitle: Devices not paired and trusted in the server registry cannot request control at all — requests are rejected before reaching your phone.
ctl.howBody: When a session starts from the computer, its touches are injected on your phone through the accessibility service with pixel precision: tap, long-press, drag, scroll, text into the focused field, and system buttons (back/home/recents). You can cut instantly from the home screen or here at any time, and control always ends when the server connection is lost.

header.title: Media & Camera — your phone is the server's eye and ear

cam.title: Quick cam — broadcast on server request
cam.idle: Mini preview appears here when streaming starts
cam.note: Audio+video stream over WebRTC to the media bridge — the web watches it as a webcam and in video calls. A system notification with a stop button appears while streaming.

shot.title: Remote shutter — photo as a file
shot.sent: Photo sent as a file: {name} — visible in your device files on the web
shot.note: On a computer command (cam:shutter) the same path runs automatically: countdown + torch, then upload through the same transfer protocol.

watch.title: Surveillance mode — continuous stream + motion
watch.note: Continuous camera stream with frame-difference motion detection (simple pixel math — no AI). On motion a sec:motion alert is pushed to the web security panel.

baby.title: Baby monitor — audio only
baby.note: Continuous microphone stream with the screen off (WakeLock prevents Doze). Loud audio pushes a baby:alert to the web.

mic.title: Phone as server microphone
mic.note: On-demand audio stream — your computer speakers hear this phone via the mic channel.

sensors.title: Sensors for the web
sensors.note: Gyroscope/accelerometer streamed over WebSocket ({count} msgs) — the web UI can later use it as a gamepad.

find.title: Find my phone
find.note: From the web guard panel («Find my phone» tab): the ring button plays max volume ignoring silent mode with vibration and screen wake — executed in the background service even with the app closed; «Light» wakes the screen and blinks the torch for 5 seconds.

err.perms: Grant camera and microphone permissions in Settings to enable streaming

rctl.offline: Control bridge offline — connect to the server first

pad.title: Touchpad — move the computer cursor
pad.hint: Drag to move · double-tap · long-press to drag · two fingers to scroll/pinch

kbd.title: Wireless keyboard (Arabic/English)
kbd.hint: Type here — keystrokes go straight to the computer

air.title: Air Mouse — phone gyroscope
air.on: Air mouse active — move your phone to steer the cursor

sys.confirmBody: This will run «{a}» on the computer — are you sure?
sys.rejected: Bridge rejected the last command ({r}) — is the PC off?
sys.macEmpty: No MAC yet — arrives automatically when the PC is ready

clip.title: Unified clipboard — phone ↔ computer
clip.watchSub: Polls every 1.5s while this screen is open (Android 10+ limit)
clip.autoSub: Or use the manual send button below
clip.empty: Nothing yet — press «Request PC clipboard» or copy there

hand.title: Continue where you left off
hand.notUrl: Shared text is not a URL — handoff accepts http/https only
hand.explain: The link appears in the «Continue where you left off» bar above the server desktop; the «Open here» button opens then removes it.

lock.title: App locked
lock.subtitle: Enter your PIN or use your fingerprint to unlock NexusLink
lock.securedBy: Protection: PBKDF2-SHA256 with 150,000 iterations — same standard as the web app

lost.title: This phone is in lost mode
lost.defaultMessage: This phone is lost — please contact its owner
lost.agentAlive: NexusLink agent is alive and reporting location to the computer
lost.imOwner: I'm the owner — cancel lost mode

sec.sessionSub: X25519 handshake with the computer over port 3009 — the server never decrypts a single frame
sec.verifyHint: Compare the SAS signature (emoji + digits) with the security screen on the web — a match proves no man-in-the-middle.
sec.lockSub: PIN or biometrics + auto-lock when leaving the app
sec.lockBioSub: Faster unlock via the device biometric prompt
sec.noBiometric: No fingerprint/face sensor on this device
sec.pinShort: Code too short — at least 4 digits
sec.permsSub: On/off key per feature + system permission status
sec.featuresLabel: System features (enforced locally and in the command gate)
sec.sysOverlaySub: Raises the lost-mode screen above anything
sec.sysBatterySub: Stops the system from killing the always-on agent
sec.lostSub: Command from the computer: lock + on-screen message + location data
sec.lostActiveBody: Active with message: "{}" — shown fullscreen while coordinates are gathered
sec.lostIdleBody: Not active — trigger it from the web app (Security → Lock phone) or when the device is actually lost
sec.lostHow: Paths: dev:lost on guard bridge 3006 · sec:lost-cmd on 3009 · encrypted lock-phone command via sec:frame
sec.wipeSub: Overwrite Download/NexusLink files then delete from MediaStore
sec.wipeEmpty: No received files in Download/NexusLink yet
sec.wipeConfirmBody: {} received files will be overwritten with {} passes then deleted — unrecoverable afterwards.
sec.bootSub: Auto-start with the system + idle behaviour with no drain
sec.autoStartSub: BootReceiver reads the last saved connection and restarts the agent on boot
sec.batteryPolicy: Idle policy: screen off and no UI → beacon every 60s and state every 120s instead of 5/30 — no wake locks while idle (except active baby monitor).
sec.workers: WorkManager: photo sync every 15 minutes + KeepAliveWorker safety net every 15 minutes if the system kills the service.

onb.welcomeSub: One platform linking your phone, computer, tablet and TV — everything local on your network, no cloud, no accounts
onb.langHint: You can change the language later from Settings
onb.permsSub: Each permission has exactly one reason, and everything stays on your device
onb.permNotifWhy: So you can see your phone's notifications on the computer and reply instantly without touching the phone
onb.permLocationWhy: Lost mode only: when triggered from the computer your phone's coordinates are sent over the encrypted channel
onb.permCameraWhy: Media features: use the phone as a webcam, monitoring, wireless microphone
onb.permMicWhy: On-demand audio streaming and baby monitoring — only runs inside a session you start
onb.permPhotosWhy: Auto-sync of new photos to the computer via WorkManager
onb.pairSub: The pairing key is exchanged via QR and end-to-end encryption starts immediately
onb.pairStep1: Open the web app on the computer on the same Wi-Fi network
onb.pairStep2: Scan the QR code from the "Connect" tab in this app
onb.pairStep3: Wait for the "online" badge — the background agent stays connected afterwards
onb.pairLater: You can pair later from the "Connect" tab at any time
onb.tourSub: Everything you see runs locally on your network
onb.hint_devices: mDNS discovery + QR pairing + smart reconnection
onb.hint_files: Browse your phone and tablet with instant previews
onb.hint_comms: Mirroring, quick reply, SMS and calls
onb.hint_media: Your phone as webcam + monitoring + streaming
onb.hint_guard: Find my phone, lost mode, proximity lock
onb.hint_security: Real E2E + audit log + secure wipe
onb.doneSub: The background agent is running now — close the app and it stays connected, with all the tools across the eight tabs
onb.doneHint: Everything you saw can be changed later from Settings — and the replay button always lives there
